what: Symbols like flowers·leaves pop out once springily from 0 when they enter the center band of the screen (−50% above and below). The flower type (default .6s) overshoots to 1.3× in the first 30% with cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), then settles .9 → 1.08 → .97 → 1.01 → 1, and the leaf type (.7s) spreads flat at 1.45 wide · .6 tall, pauses briefly (32~42%), shoots up to .7 wide · 1.3 tall, then settles 1.15·.9 → .95·1.04 → 1

options.look: flower (default, even) · leaf (squashes alternately wide and tall)
options.delay: Delay (s), default 0 — the original sets the flower .5 later than the leaves

from.where: index.css .statement__flower(flower-boyoyon .6s .5s · leaf-boing .7s) · about.css scattered flowers·leaves · clap star · speech bubble
